title: 500 important missing buildings and landmarks
coordinateBasis: Reference points for planning. Confirm the physical footprint and orientation against PMTiles and photos during authoring.
priorityBasis: Recognizable independent structures and scoped heritage landmarks, selected by combined cross-language visibility, architectural and cultural significance, and regional coverage.

selectionSources.title: Wikidata structure-class snapshot and scoped public entity lookups

entries.title: Great Sphinx of Giza
entries.scope: The visible limestone figure and its carved body down to the mapped enclosure floor. The Sphinx Temple and Khafre Valley Temple remain distinct structures.
entries.priorityBasis: Missing principal Giza monument beside the existing Khufu pyramid.

entries.title: Pyramid of Khafre
entries.scope: Surviving pyramid exterior, including the distinctive upper casing. Keep the mortuary and valley temples as separate footprints.
entries.priorityBasis: Missing principal Giza monument beside the existing Khufu pyramid.

entries.title: Pyramid of Menkaure
entries.scope: Surviving main pyramid, lower granite casing and north-face breach. Keep the three satellite pyramids separate.
entries.priorityBasis: Missing principal Giza monument beside the existing Khufu pyramid.

entries.title: Leaning Tower of Pisa
entries.scope: The freestanding leaning campanile, with its open circular arcades. The cathedral and baptistery are separate buildings.

entries.title: Borobudur Temple
entries.scope: The main Borobudur stepped stone monument, upper terraces and perforated stupas. Separate nearby temples stay out of this scope.

entries.title: Himeji Castle
entries.scope: The main keep and its connected smaller keeps. Separate gates and outer walls require their own scopes.

entries.title: Temple of Ephesian Artemis
entries.scope: Show the surviving archaeological remains and reconstructed column in their present condition.

entries.title: Prambanan Temple
entries.scope: The main Prambanan Hindu temple enclosure. Confirm individual shrine footprints and retain the surrounding sites as separate landmarks.

entries.title: Itsukushima Shrine
entries.scope: The waterside shrine complex and its identifying rooflines. Treat the offshore torii as a separate footprint within the site.

entries.title: Mahabodhi Temple
entries.scope: The principal temple tower and attached shrine footprint. Reconcile independently located elements of the wider Bodh Gaya site.

entries.title: Cologne Cathedral
entries.scope: The cathedral exterior with its twin spires, transepts, flying buttresses and choir. Surrounding plaza and railway station stay separate.

entries.title: Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial
Great Zimbabwe
entries.scope: The surviving dry-stone Great Enclosure and its conical tower. Locate the enclosure footprint independently of the wider archaeological site.

entries.title: Citadel of the Hồ Dynasty
entries.scope: The surviving stone gates and immediately adjoining citadel curtain walls. Locate each section against the map rather than the property centroid.

entries.title: Augustusburg and Falkenlust Palaces
entries.scope: The principal Augustusburg Palace exterior. Treat the detached Falkenlust lodge as independent.

collections.title: Painted Churches in the Troödos Region

membershipEvidence.note: The ten churches and monasteries listed by UNESCO and Visit Cyprus match independently named OpenStreetMap ways. Each has its own model, placement and source bundle.

membershipEvidence.basis: The three listed sites are represented by the visible core of Bat Necropolis and five surveyed tower locations at Bat, the monumental tower at Al-Khutm, and the twenty individually mapped tombs at Al-Ayn.
